programChanges.summary: Second preview release with CSV-backed task editing, hierarchical drag and drop, folder attachments, rich notes, and a refined graphite interface
added: Hierarchical drag and drop with child, sibling, and root placement
Unified file and folder attachment picker
Selection-based rich-note bold and RGB/CMYK color formatting
changed: Connected the main page exclusively to event.csv with dirty-only five-minute persistence
Rebuilt the main page with the finalized compact graphite visual system
Improved hover-detail lifecycle, focus release, scrolling, sorting, and reorder animation
Hardened schema_version decoding and event snapshot validation
Applied a true rounded alpha mask to the complete window background
